title: Topic table
description: Shape of packages/contracts/topics.json, the single description of the MQTT topic tree. Meta schemas describe configuration files rather than messages, so their $id lives in the urn:fdp:meta namespace and never appears in a message's schema field.

roots.description: The two top-level roots. Every topic template starts with one of them.

topics.description: One entry per topic, keyed by the snake_case name the generated builders are derived from.

acl.description: Read and write filters per broker credential, rendered into infra/mosquitto/acl.

topic.title: Topic entry
topic.description: One topic: its template, the v1 schema its payload validates against, and how it is published.

acl_entry.title: ACL entry
acl_entry.description: The topic filters one credential may subscribe to and publish on. Both lists are required; an empty list means no access.
